description:
How can you strengthen your faith, eliminate doubt, and stand strong? Find out on this episode of 3ABN Today Bible Q & A with host, Ricky Carter, James Rafferty, Daniel Perrin, and Shelley Quinn.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.     As a child of God, what can I do to strengthen my faith and get closer to God? 

2.      I believe there is one lesson God wants us to take from the Bible and that is to love. Across the Bible, God displays how much He loves us. Am I wrong in thinking that the thing above all that God and Christ want for us is to love? And if I am not wrong, do you think this is what we should be focusing our hearts and lives on? Is the main lesson of the Bible to love? 

3.      I believe in God & have faith in God. When difficult situations come up I say that God will take care of them. However, in my mind, I wonder "what if" God doesn't take care of it? How do I handle this and what would my unbelieving friends think? How do I eliminate doubt & stand strong in my faith? 

4.      Can you please explain how Jesus died the second death but didn't go to the lake of fire? 

5.   I understand that we are to give 10% tithe and offering. Is that supposed to be off our gross or net income? Do we tithe on our gross or net income? 

6.   When were the dinosaurs here?

7.  If Michael stands up once (Daniel 12:1) why do people teach probation closes twice? Once for the church and once for everyone else. I've heard Pastors say when the Sunday laws are passed the church's probation closes. Yet Michael stands once. Why do some teach that probation closes twice?  

8.   Which Israel is Paul referencing in Romans 11:26? 

9.   I heard a Pastor say that Jesus' name is Yeshua and that means Joshua in English. Some say that his real name is Jesus. Would you please explain? What is Jesus' real name? 

10.  I know the Bible says that no one knows the hour of Christ's return, not even the Son. So why are there people predicting the time of Christ's return? The Bible says there will be prophets prophesying His return. I read a story about one in Colorado who said Christ would "rapture" in 2011. Some preachers are telling people that 2027 is the Lord's coming. The Bible says"even the elect will be deceived." Is this all correct? I think we are in the time of Revelation 14 to 17. Please help! Why are there people predicting the time of Christ's return?  

11.  Are Jewish people still saved because they are heirs to Abraham even if they don't believe in Jesus? Will Jewish people be in eternity? 

12.   How can I make sense of the commandment to honor thy father and mother when a parent is not a good parent, but toxic? How do I honor a toxic parent? 

  
 
TDYQA230004
